summary: DEFAULT_VAULT_IDENTITY_LIST sets default vault IDs and password sources used whenever --vault-id isn't given; multiple values act like multiple --vault-id options.
questions: How do I set a default vault ID so I don't have to pass --vault-id every time?

answer_card.title: Set a default vault ID
answer_card.answer_md: Set the config option **`DEFAULT_VAULT_IDENTITY_LIST`** to a default vault ID and password source. Ansible uses it whenever you don't pass `--vault-id`. Multiple values are equivalent to multiple `--vault-id` options.
